SPOT_PRICE.NAME: Spot price
SPOT_PRICE.DESCRIPTION: Day-ahead electricity prices (aWATTar AT/DE or ENTSO-E) with cheapest-hours outputs

PROVIDER.NAME: Provider
PROVIDER.DESCRIPTION: aWATTar needs no key (fair use: 100 requests a day). ENTSO-E needs a security token and works for every bidding zone

TOKEN.NAME: ENTSO-E security token
TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Only for ENTSO-E: request API access by e-mail to transparency@entsoe.eu, then create the token in your account on transparency.entsoe.eu

ZONE.NAME: ENTSO-E bidding zone
ZONE.DESCRIPTION: EIC code of the bidding zone, only for ENTSO-E. Austria 10YAT-APG------L, Germany/Luxembourg 10Y1001A1001A82H

SURCHARGE.NAME: Surcharge [EUR/kWh]
SURCHARGE.DESCRIPTION: Added to the market price before VAT: supplier fee, grid fees, levies. 0 = market price only

VAT.NAME: VAT [%]
VAT.DESCRIPTION: Applied to market price + surcharge, e.g. 20 for Austria, 19 for Germany. 0 = net prices

REFRESH.NAME: Refresh interval [min]
REFRESH.DESCRIPTION: How often the prices are fetched. While tomorrow's prices are missing, the driver asks every 15 minutes

API_URL.NAME: API URL
API_URL.DESCRIPTION: Optional. Empty = the provider's default (https://api.awattar.at, https://api.awattar.de, https://web-api.tp.entsoe.eu/api)

PRICE_NOW.NAME: Price now [EUR/kWh]
PRICE_NOW.DESCRIPTION: Current price with surcharge and VAT, e.g. for the import price of the energy monitor

MARKET_PRICE_NOW.NAME: Market price now [EUR/kWh]
MARKET_PRICE_NOW.DESCRIPTION: Current day-ahead market price, net, without surcharge

PRICE_NEXT_HOUR.NAME: Price next hour [EUR/kWh]
PRICE_NEXT_HOUR.DESCRIPTION: Average price of the next full hour, with surcharge and VAT

PRICES_UNTIL.NAME: Prices known until
PRICES_UNTIL.DESCRIPTION: End of the last known price slot (local time)

WINDOW.NAME: Cheapest hours
WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: true during the cheapest (or most expensive) hours of each period, e.g. the cheapest 3 hours in 24 hours

HOURS.NAME: Hours
HOURS.DESCRIPTION: Length of the window in hours (also quarter hours, e.g. 1.5)

PERIOD.NAME: Period [h]
PERIOD.DESCRIPTION: The window is chosen once per period of this many hours. A started window is kept, so the output is on for exactly the given hours per period

CONTIGUOUS.NAME: Contiguous
CONTIGUOUS.DESCRIPTION: On: one block of hours in a row (e.g. a dishwasher). Off: the cheapest single slots (e.g. a boiler)

MODE.NAME: Mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Cheapest or most expensive hours (e.g. to block loads at peak prices)
